inspection_method: Actual visual inspection of exact native original and both Pillow QA reductions. Manual transcription; no OCR or pixel editing. Equal means observed visual transcription, not recovered underlying text encoding.

views.findings: All seven supplied lines are readable. Large title spans the two states; lid edges, green surface, folds, shadows and the entire background inspected.

Title and cup comparison read first. Korean line, specification, release, preorder and URL remain readable without overlaps; lower sales grouping uses centered alignment while the upper smaller copy sits at right.

Fold Cup and two cup heights dominate. Full date and URL can still be read; Korean slogan, specification and preorder are much smaller, so punctuation and exact fine Hangul strokes require the larger views.

copy_check.observation: Space between 350 and mL is visibly present; lowercase m and uppercase L are readable. Middle-dot form is visible.
Visual manual transcription matches wording and dates. The visible horizontal separator appears en-dash-like, but exact Unicode and literal spacing cannot be proved from raster pixels alone.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: This role makes only one independent flat poster; coordinator manages total two.
mandatory_conditions.observed: One native output file produced by one fresh no-reference call. No panel split, mockup or secondary image.
Native output is 1122×1402, ratio 561:701 = 0.8002853067. Requested 4:5 = 0.8. Width×5 is 5610; height×4 is 5608.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Seven exact supplied copy items, preserving Korean, case, spaces, numbers, units, dates, dash and URL.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Seven items visually transcribed above; no extra visible copy, duplicated headline or fake microtext found. Exact Unicode/typographic spacing remains a raster limitation.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Photo-like handleless cup, dark-green silicone body and translucent white lid.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Expanded cup at native [63,448,553,1079] and collapsed cup at [581,714,1045,1088]. Matte fine-textured dark-green bodies, pale translucent lids with rounded edges, coherent ellipses, floor contacts and soft upper-left light are visible.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Same fictional broad round rim, soft horizontal fold sections, tapering body, flat base, same-diameter circular translucent-white lid, no hinge.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Both states are upright and visibly handleless, broad circular lids, tapering green bodies and flat floor-contact bottoms. Tall body has alternating broad molded folding sections; short body has nested broad sections. Projected lid widths are similar rather than pixel-identical; no hinge seen.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: No actual brand/logo or product-surface text; supplied FOLN belongs only to poster.
mandatory_conditions.observed: FOLN appears only at upper left. Both green bodies and lid surfaces have no lettering, emblems or markings. No pricing, performance/certification badges or invented microtext found across frame.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Two cup heights organize photograph/title/information; Fold Cup on one line spans both states; shorter state opens space for Korean copy leading into sales info.
mandatory_conditions.observed: One-line Fold Cup spans the whole group above. Slogan/specification occupy the right-side area above the collapsed cup. Release/preorder/URL form a three-line group immediately beneath the shared product baseline. No separate name column or unrelated large empty field.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Do not certify actual 350mL capacity or physically verified operation.
mandatory_conditions.observed: 350 mL is supplied poster copy. Image shows an imagined state comparison; no measurements or physical operation testing occurred, and none are claimed.
